question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a silver present, Bob has a green present, and Claire has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) silver present
(B) green present
(C) teal present
solution:
Each row lists the gift colors in person order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: silver | green | teal
1. Alice–Claire: teal | green | silver
2. Bob–Claire: teal | silver | green
3. Bob–Alice: silver | teal | green
Claire has the green present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
